resources.string: %1$s at row %2$d, column %3$d. Board size %4$d by %5$d.
Reach the green exit with the blue Monster before enemies corner you.
Green - exit to the next level
Blue - Monster, the character you control

Use arrows, keyboard, D-pad, swipe, or tap the board to move one cell.
The red Kryvavitsa hunts the Monster. Purple lesser Kryvavitsas wander randomly.
Push gray walls into free cells to clear a path. The thick border blocks leaving the board.
Score: -10 per move, +10 for pushing a wall, +50 for crushing a purple enemy, +1000 for reaching the exit.
If any enemy reaches the same or neighboring cell, the game ends.
Enables a local turn-based puzzle. The game stays off until you turn it on.
Show the game in the main menu and launcher widget
Kryvavitsa caught you. Start a new game to try again.
This board cannot be played. Change its size or open a preset board.
Exit reached. Start the next level when ready.
Saved game state was reset. A new game is ready.
This board may be too dense on this screen. Use zoom or choose a smaller board.
Reach the door with the man before the woman with the machine gun and her knife-wielding helpers corner you.
Woman with a machine gun - the Kryvavitsa, hunts you
Woman with a knife - lesser Kryvavitsa, moves randomly
Door - exit to the next level

Use arrows, keyboard, D-pad, swipe, or tap the board to move one cell.
The woman with the machine gun hunts the man. Her knife-wielding helpers wander randomly, stomping as they move.
Push black walls into free cells to clear a path. The thick border blocks leaving the board.
Score: -10 per move, +10 for pushing a wall, +50 for crushing a helper, +1000 for reaching the door.
If any enemy reaches the same or neighboring cell, the game ends.
